metadata.title: Secure‑SDLC OT / Safety‑Critical SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan specializing Secure‑SDLC for Operational Technology (OT) and safety‑critical software development contexts.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits Secure‑SDLC Platform rules and applies additional safety-critical constraints appropriate for OT environments.

system-characteristics.system-description: This environment governs development of software, logic, and configuration that may directly or indirectly affect physical processes, equipment, or safety systems. It enforces conservative delivery practices, explicit manual authorization, and strict separation between SDLC completion and operational enablement.

props.name: domain
props.remarks: Applies to PLC logic, robotics software, industrial controllers, building automation, and safety‑critical control systems.

props.name: state-assumption
props.remarks: OT software may cause irreversible physical effects.

props.name: delivery-frequency
props.remarks: Changes are infrequent and carefully staged.

props.name: automation-level
props.remarks: CI/CD automation is limited and subject to manual safety review.

props.name: implicit-deploy
props.remarks: No SDLC outcome may automatically deploy or activate OT software.

props.name: implicit-energization
props.remarks: Signed or assured software must not energize, actuate, or control equipment without explicit operational authorization.

props.name: authority-source
props.remarks: Operational enablement authority resides with OT safety governance, not SDLC.

props.name: manual-review
props.remarks: Human safety review is required prior to any OT software promotion.

system-implementation.remarks: OT SDLC is implemented through Secure‑SDLC patterns with strict constraints on automation, mandatory safety review, and explicit separation between delivery and physical enablement.

components.title: SDLC Core
components.remarks: Defines SDLC legitimacy and non‑equivalence rules.

components.title: SDLC Identity and Attribution
components.remarks: Maintains human accountability for all OT‑related SDLC actions.

components.title: SDLC Change Integrity
components.remarks: Ensures OT software and configuration integrity without authorizing execution.

components.title: SDLC Assurance
components.remarks: Provides assurance evidence, not safety certification.

components.title: SDLC Supply Chain
components.remarks: Constrains external OT software components and tooling.

components.title: SDLC Operations Handover
components.remarks: Transfers custody of OT software artifacts without enabling execution.

roles.title: OT SDLC Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines SDLC constraints specific to OT and safety‑critical software.

roles.title: OT SDLC Governance
roles.remarks: Owns OT software lifecycle policies and approval thresholds.

roles.title: OT Safety Authority
roles.remarks: Provides explicit authorization prior to any operational activation.

roles.title: OT SDLC Operations
roles.remarks: Manages SDLC tooling without deployment authority.

roles.title: OT Deployment Operations
roles.remarks: Executes physical enablement and commissioning under safety governance.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through Secure‑SDLC interpretation of NIST SP 800‑53 control families SA, CM, IA, AU, SI, and SR, with operational safety enforced through Secure‑Resilience and Secure‑Device SSPPs.
